apps.name: McOS Browser
apps.about: Browse the whole web from McOS: YouTube, JavaScript sites, logins and web apps. The Minecraft server runs a real browser engine (Chromium) for your computer and shows it in this window, with sound. Downloads go to Downloads (an .mca opens in the App Installer). Needs MCPC mod mcpc58 or newer (mcpc59 recommended); on a dedicated server the owner turns the web on (-Dmcpc.web=on). Films on Netflix-style sites need a licence the engine doesn't have.
apps.whatsnew: When a page can't open you now see why (instead of a blank page). Needs mod mcpc59 for the clearest reasons.

apps.name: Sticky Notes
apps.about: Quick notes in six colours. Everything saves as you type, and your notes are there next time. Search, Ctrl+N for a new note, emoji welcome.
apps.whatsnew: Adds a screenshot to its Store page.
